artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan formalizing the branch-gated section extraction convention, its lint (verify-deploy Gate 19), fixture test, and one measured pilot extraction on skill-email-cleanup.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's source store, agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json declares provides.context as a WHOLESALE directory list (e.g. "patterns"), but provides.scripts as an INDIVIDUALLY ENUMERATED file list including every lint/lint-*.sh and tests/test-*.sh path. Consequence: a new context/patterns/*.md file deploys with no manifest edit (only an index-entries.json entry), while a new script or test file is SILENTLY NEVER DEPLOYED unless explicitly added to provides.scripts. The failure is silent -- the file exists in the source store, verify-deploy passes locally when invoked from the source store, and only a deployed-tree check catches it. Always check whether the relevant provides.* key is wholesale or enumerated before assuming no manifest edit is needed; the two keys differ within the same manifest file.
